title: Implement FAQ section variants (faq-accordion, faq-two-col)
description: Implement two FAQ section variants. faq-accordion shows questions that expand/collapse one at a time. faq-two-col shows all Q&As in a two-column static layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: FaqContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render all FAQ items with question and answer
faq-accordion uses shadcn/ui Accordion or custom accordion with smooth expand/collapse
faq-two-col splits items into two equal columns on desktop
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Headline + accordion list. Use shadcn/ui Accordion component: `<Accordion type='single' collapsible>`. Each item: `<AccordionItem>` with `<AccordionTrigger>` (question) and `<AccordionContent>` (answer).

Static server component. Headline + `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8`. Each item: question as h3 (bold, `--color-heading`), answer as p below. First half of items in column 1, second half in column 2.
Take Playwright screenshot. Click an accordion item and verify it expands. Verify two-col layout is correct on desktop.
